report.explanation: All checkout requests returned 200; only one 344ms outlier against a 78-94ms baseline. Gateway logs show the slow span is the /v1/orders client call to order, but no order-side telemetry, dependency metrics, or error evidence is available. Deployment record proves only gateway v1.0.0. Insufficient to bound a root cause; hand off.
missing_evidence: Order service latency/error telemetry for the slow /v1/orders call window
Dependency operation metrics (order->inventory, payment, postgresql) to localize the 344ms outlier
Error or timeout logs from order, inventory, payment, or postgresql
Sustained latency distribution (p95/p99 over longer window) to confirm whether 344ms is anomalous
